title: Declarative binding
description: A tier-1 adapter: a YAML document the runner's generic HTTP engine interprets deterministically (SPEC.md §10a, ADR-022). Validate after decoding the YAML to JSON. Deliberately ~8 primitives; the moment a binding needs logic it graduates to a process adapter — no expression language may ever grow in here. DRAFT: authored in the ADR-022..029 reconciliation pass ahead of the binding-engine build; conformance tests will harden it.

id.description: Adapter id, e.g. 'attio/assert'. Named by the contract owner (ADR-026).

role.description: source: pagination + cursor/STATE; enrich: per-record request; deliver: idempotency + dry-run receipts.

needs.description: Same manifest surface as process adapters (SPEC.md §6): a JSON Schema, 'dynamic', or the dynamic-with-floor object form.

provides.description: Same manifest surface as process adapters (SPEC.md §6).

name.description: Header or query-param name; unused for basic/bearer.

env.description: Env var holding the credential (resolved per SPEC.md §6 credentials rules).

prefix.description: Optional literal prefix for the value, e.g. 'Bearer '.

request.description: Templating draws only from step config and the record's canonical fields — no expressions, no computation.

body.description: Body template (JSON shape with templated string leaves).

cursor_path.description: JSONPath to the next cursor in the response (cursor strategy).

empty_records.description: Stop when a page yields zero records.

path.description: JSONPath whose falsy/absent value stops pagination.

records.description: JSONPath to the record array (or single record) in the response.

fields.description: canonical (or vendor-namespaced) field name -> extraction rule.

transform.description: A registry normalization rule id (SPEC.md §4a) — never arbitrary logic.

errors.description: HTTP status (or status class like '4xx') -> verdict mapping.

idempotency.description: Which party guarantees delivery dedupe: the vendor's own semantics (native, e.g. an assert/upsert endpoint) or the runner's deliveries table (ledger). Required for role: deliver.

unit_path.description: JSONPath to a units-consumed count in the response (per: unit).

session.description: Optional pagination-consistency session: a UUID minted per run and passed through on every request.
